schema_fields.name: wiki_db
schema_fields.description: enwiki, dewiki, eswiktionary, etc.

schema_fields.name: event_log_id
schema_fields.description: In page/user events: id of the logging table row that caused this event. NULL for revision events.

schema_fields.name: event_entity
schema_fields.description: revision, user or page

schema_fields.name: event_type
schema_fields.description: create, move, delete, etc. Detailed explanation in the docs under #Event_types

schema_fields.name: event_timestamp
schema_fields.description: When this event ocurred

schema_fields.name: event_comment
schema_fields.description: Comment related to this event, sourced from log_comment, rev_comment, etc.

schema_fields.name: event_user_id
schema_fields.description: ID of the user that caused the event. Null if the user is anonymous or if from a revision where the user has been revision deleted.

schema_fields.name: event_user_central_id
schema_fields.description: Global (central) ID of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_text_historical
schema_fields.description: Historical username (IP address for anonymous user) of the user that caused the event. Null for revisions where the user has been revision deleted.

schema_fields.name: event_user_text
schema_fields.description: Current username of the user that caused the event. Null for anonymous users (the IP is stored in event_user_text_historical). Null for revisions where the user has been revision deleted.

schema_fields.name: event_user_blocks_historical
schema_fields.description: Historical blocks of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_blocks
schema_fields.description: Current blocks of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_groups_historical
schema_fields.description: Historical groups of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_groups
schema_fields.description: Current groups of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_bot_by_historical
schema_fields.description: Historical bot information of the user that caused the event, can contain values name or group

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_bot_by
schema_fields.description: Bot information of the user that caused the event, can contain values name or group

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_created_by_self
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user created their own account

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_created_by_system
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user account was created by mediawiki (eg. centralauth)

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_created_by_peer
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user account was created by another user

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_anonymous
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user is not registered, using the old way that surfaced the IP publicly. True for revisions where the user has been revision deleted, even if the user was actually registered.

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_temporary
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user is not registered, using the new temporary account way. True for revisions where the user has been revision deleted, even if the user was actually registered.

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_permanent
schema_fields.description: Whether the event_user is registered.

schema_fields.name: event_user_is_cross_wiki
schema_fields.description: True if the event_user is an interwiki-imported editor (usertext contains ">", is anonymous, and not temporary). NULL for user/page events.

schema_fields.name: event_user_registration_timestamp
schema_fields.description: Registration timestamp of the user that caused the event (from user table)

schema_fields.name: event_user_creation_timestamp
schema_fields.description: Creation timestamp of the user that caused the event (from logging table)

schema_fields.name: event_user_first_edit_timestamp
schema_fields.description: Timestamp of the first edit of the user that caused the event

schema_fields.name: event_user_revision_count
schema_fields.description: Number of revisions made by the event_user up to the historical time in this wiki_db (only available in revision-create events so far). For revision-create events, this includes the event itself.

schema_fields.name: event_user_seconds_since_previous_revision
schema_fields.description: In revision events: seconds elapsed since the previous revision made by the current event_user_id (only available in revision-create events so far)

schema_fields.name: page_id
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: id of the page

schema_fields.name: page_title_historical
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: historical title of the page

schema_fields.name: page_title
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: current title of the page

schema_fields.name: page_namespace_historical
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: historical namespace of the page.

schema_fields.name: page_namespace_is_content_historical
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: historical namespace of the page is categorized as content

schema_fields.name: page_namespace
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: current namespace of the page

schema_fields.name: page_namespace_is_content
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: current namespace of the page is categorized as content

schema_fields.name: page_is_redirect
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: whether the page is currently a redirect

schema_fields.name: page_is_deleted
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: Whether the page is rebuilt from a delete event

schema_fields.name: page_creation_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: creation timestamp of the page

schema_fields.name: page_first_edit_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: timestamp of the page's first revision. Can be before the page_creation in some restore/merge cases (see revision_is_from_before_page_creation).

schema_fields.name: page_revision_count
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: Cumulative revision count per page for the current page_id (only available in revision-create events so far)

schema_fields.name: page_seconds_since_previous_revision
schema_fields.description: In revision/page events: seconds elapsed since the previous revision made on the current page_id (only available in revision-create events so far)

schema_fields.name: user_id
schema_fields.description: In user events: id of the user

schema_fields.name: user_central_id
schema_fields.description: In user events: global (central) id of the user

schema_fields.name: user_text_historical
schema_fields.description: In user events: historical username or IP address of the user

schema_fields.name: user_text
schema_fields.description: In user events: current username or IP address of the user

schema_fields.name: user_blocks_historical
schema_fields.description: In user events: historical user blocks

schema_fields.name: user_blocks
schema_fields.description: In user events: current user blocks

schema_fields.name: user_groups_historical
schema_fields.description: In user events: historical user groups

schema_fields.name: user_groups
schema_fields.description: In user events: current user groups

schema_fields.name: user_is_bot_by_historical
schema_fields.description: In user events: Historical bot information of the user, can contain values name or group

schema_fields.name: user_is_bot_by
schema_fields.description: In user events: Bot information of the user, can contain values name or group

schema_fields.name: user_is_created_by_self
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user created their own account

schema_fields.name: user_is_created_by_system
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user account was created by mediawiki

schema_fields.name: user_is_created_by_peer
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user account was created by another user

schema_fields.name: user_is_anonymous
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user is not registered, using the old way that surfaced the IP publicly

schema_fields.name: user_is_temporary
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user is not registered, using the new temporary account way

schema_fields.name: user_is_permanent
schema_fields.description: In user events: whether the user is registered

schema_fields.name: user_registration_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In user events: registration timestamp of the user.

schema_fields.name: user_creation_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In user events: Creation timestamp of the user (from logging table)

schema_fields.name: user_first_edit_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In user events: Timestamp of the first edit of the user

schema_fields.name: revision_id
schema_fields.description: In revision events: id of the revision

schema_fields.name: revision_parent_id
schema_fields.description: In revision events: id of the parent revision

schema_fields.name: revision_minor_edit
schema_fields.description: In revision events: whether it is a minor edit or not

schema_fields.name: revision_deleted_parts
schema_fields.description: In revision events: Deleted parts of the revision, can contain values text, comment and user

schema_fields.name: revision_deleted_parts_are_suppressed
schema_fields.description: In revision events: Whether the deleted parts are deleted to admin as well (visible only by stewards)

schema_fields.name: revision_text_bytes
schema_fields.description: In revision events: number of bytes of revision

schema_fields.name: revision_text_bytes_diff
schema_fields.description: In revision events: change in bytes relative to parent revision (can be negative).

schema_fields.name: revision_text_sha1
schema_fields.description: In revision events: sha1 hash of the revision

schema_fields.name: revision_content_model
schema_fields.description: In revision events: content model of revision

schema_fields.name: revision_content_format
schema_fields.description: In revision events: content format of revision

schema_fields.name: revision_is_deleted_by_page_deletion
schema_fields.description: In revision events: whether this revision has been deleted (moved to archive table)

schema_fields.name: revision_deleted_by_page_deletion_timestamp
schema_fields.description: In revision events: the timestamp when the revision was deleted

schema_fields.name: revision_is_identity_reverted
schema_fields.description: In revision events: whether this revision was reverted by another future revision

schema_fields.name: revision_first_identity_reverting_revision_id
schema_fields.description: In revision events: id of the revision that reverted this revision

schema_fields.name: revision_seconds_to_identity_revert
schema_fields.description: In revision events: seconds elapsed between revision posting and its revert (if there was one)

schema_fields.name: revision_is_identity_revert
schema_fields.description: In revision events: whether this revision reverts other revisions

schema_fields.name: revision_is_from_before_page_creation
schema_fields.description: In revision events: True if the revision timestamp is before the page creation (can happen with restore events)

schema_fields.name: revision_tags
schema_fields.description: In revision events: Tags associated to the revision

schema_count_note: Current detailed public schema and all observed rows78; overview still states76. Internal HQL also has page_artificial_id and snapshot omitted from publicTSV.
